# Reverie Brooklyn, Williamsburg - Menu

## A fully vegan restaurant and cocktail bar led by acclaimed chef Guy Vaknin. From the team behind Beyond Sushi and other City Roots concepts, the menu delivers elevated, globally inspired small plates designed for sharing. Standout dishes include parsnip truffle vol-au-vent, leek confit, mushroom flatbread, and yuzu cheesecake, paired with inventive cocktails and curated wines. Ideal for date nights, happy hour, or relaxed evenings with friends, Reverie blends comfort, creativity, and refinement into a memorable plant-based dini
